title: Successor prime-power extension step
statement: For a property P of lifted-integer modules invariant under isomorphism and closed under short exact extensions, if r is prime, P holds for lifted ZMod (r ^ e) and lifted ZMod r, then P holds for lifted ZMod (r ^ (e + 1)).

proof.text: Set a = r ^ e > 0. The maps i([x]) = [r*x] from Z/a to Z/(a*r), and q([y]) = [y] from Z/(a*r) to Z/r, are well-defined integer-linear maps. Cancellation of r proves i injective; integer representatives prove q surjective; r divides y exactly when [y] lies in the image of i, proving exactness. Lift this short exact sequence to ULift modules, identify a*r with r ^ (e+1), and apply extension closure to hind and hprime, transporting along the canonical module isomorphisms.
